composition: A live slider occupies the upper stage. Below, stacked spec blocks (Configure / Read / Events / In Use) in a narrow ragged column. Slide cards show serial + title + identical price.
typography: Utilitarian grotesque, mixed case, long running titles ('Configurable customisable extendable…'). Serials are tabular (0000). No display serif.
palette: Light workbench field, near-black type, one quiet price color. Not a dark shader theater.
geometry: Slides sized by CSS offsets. Spec blocks full measure of a reading column. No 12-col marketing grid.
navigation: None to speak of. GitHub is the other room.
hero: The slider itself, already moving / draggable on load.
motion: Lerp/damp toward target. Snap optional. Infinite loop optional. Drag power is a parameter. Settling is the motion character.
interaction: Drag, wheel, trackpad. Events fire SETTLED / IN VIEW / INITIALISED. Parallax factor per slide is readable.
imagery: Placeholder objects as SKUs. 3D models listed in credits, used as slides not as a brand world.
materials: Paper UI. The smoothness is in the integrator, not in glass.
spatial_rhythm: Demo → spec → framework notes → in-the-wild list. Short sections.
responsive: Slider can disable below a breakpoint (the API supports conditional activation). Spec column goes full width.
signature_motif: Live slider + printed telemetry on a receipt-like page
rejected_defaults: docs in a left sidebar + markdown
